title: cotula hispida
intro: Cotula hispida, commonly known as Bitterweed or False Mayweed, is a flowering plant native to Australia and New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Cotula hispida include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve digestive issues, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant and anti-cancer agent. The bioactive constituents of Cotula hispida include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant for further research and potential use in traditional medicine.
